sources.note: Envelope 200 x 40 x 20 mm in x,y,z; y up. Tool origin at minimum corner.
Steel is stated; isotropic linear elastic E=210000 N/mm^2 and Poisson ratio 0.30 are assumed because grade and constants are not specified.
Brief specifies 1 mm elements; h=1 mm.

Brief states single freely rotating z hinge at x=10,y=20 spanning thickness. Idealize with x,y,z translation restraints only on axis line z=0..20, assuming axial retention; rotation about z remains free. No other restraints.

Brief states 400 N downward at x=200 on 10 mm tall strip centered at y=20 across full 20 mm thickness. Thus vector (0,-400,0) N, y bounds 20 +/- 5 = 15..25, z=0..20, face patch center(y,z)=(20,10), size=(10,20). Equal nodal force distribution is assumed; no passive regions specified or added.

final: REFUSE — The freely rotating hinge cannot resist the load’s 76 N·m moment about z; validation confirms an unconstrained rotation, so static equilibrium is impossible as stated.

spec.name: Hinged support arm

supports.note: Ideal revolute hinge: constrain translations along the pin axis line while leaving rigid rotation about z free. Axis and full-thickness span from brief; assume axial retention. No support radius or clamped area added.

loads.note: Total downward 400 N shared equally among selected strip nodes. Strip y=15..25 derived from 10 mm height centered at y=20; full thickness z=0..20.

spec.description: 200 x 40 x 20 mm arm; y up. Single freely rotating hinge along z at x=10, y=20 mm. Downward 400 N total on x=200 face, y=15..25, z=0..20. Ideal hinge represented by constrained axis nodes, retaining rotation about z. No other restraints and no passive regions. Static equilibrium must be checked: applied moment about hinge z is -76000 N mm.
